thread:
Nisha: Quick sync — we need a concise launch checklist for the new smoothing + fallback ordering feature. customers asking for consistent latencies during bursts, but we must avoid cross-tenant unfairness.
Cheng: Agree. Proposed constraint: smoothing_window=30s default, per-tenant max_burst=1.5x baseline.
Samir: Ops question — how do we rollback if smoothing causes higher p95? Need clear metric thresholds.
Nisha: Good point. Launch criteria idea: 1) p95 tail under SLA during 90th percentile of test traffic; 2) no >5% error amplification for low-tier tenants.
Maria: From sales: customers will need opt-in and a clear opt-out path. Add a toggle in console + API.
Olivia: We should expose a telemetry flag: "smoothing.mode=graceful|aggressive|off". default graceful.
Cheng: Implementation: runtime will insert a leaky-bucket stage before batching. Pseudocode:
```yaml
smoothing:
  mode: graceful
  window_ms: 30000
  max_multiplier: 1.5
  fallback_policy: preempt_low_priority_first
```
Samir: For rollback: ops-runbook should include an automated canary abort when p50 increased by >10% for any canary tenant and p95 > SLA.
Nisha: Add a manual rollback path in console + API: /rollout/abort with auto-fallback to previous model variant.
Ops-bot: deploy started for feature/smoothing-staged-canary on cluster-us-west-2 (job id: deploy-4021) :rocket:
Cheng: We'll route 1% traffic for 24h across 10 tenants. Need monitoring: per-tenant latency percentiles, error-rate, and burst-credit consumption.
Maria: Sales asks for a contract addendum that guarantees no cross-tenant spillover for paying customers. How do we quantify it?
Olivia: Proposal: reserved_pools: a tenant with reserved pool has hard spill cap set to 0.2 * pool_size during smoothing. That should protect SLAs.
Samir: Need to test preemption ordering: prefer evict best-effort tasks instead of reserved ones. Confirm in the playbook.
Nisha: Action items: Cheng to implement leaky-bucket + fallback hooks (ETA 2w). Samir to draft rollback playbook (ETA 3d). Olivia to spec telemetry flags + API (ETA 4d). Maria to coordinate with beta customers (ETA 1w).
Cheng: I'll add metrics: smoothing.window_effective, smoothing.evictions, smoothing.latency_delta.
Samir: Also include an alert: if smoothing.evictions > 50 in 1h for a reserved tenant, trigger immediate rollback.
Nisha: Decision: go ahead with staged canary. Final signoff from Eng, SRE, Product required before rollout to GA.
Maria: I'll line up three pilot customers who want lower p99 spikes but care about hard isolation.
Olivia: One more: We should add an API to preview expected latency change for a tenant given current traffic profile.
Cheng: We can compute estimate offline using the simulator — will add endpoint /simulate/smoothing.
Nisha: Thanks team. I'll turn this into the lightweight checklist and share. :thumbsup:
